title: Example Brand (seed record — delete after first real run)
summary: ~$180k/mo on a theme they've outgrown. Founder-led, publicly active, three high-severity PDP leaks.
Subscribe-and-save exists but lives off the PDP — the single highest-value, easiest-to-demo fix.

sections.h: Why this is a good lead

blocks.p: This record is a worked example of the exact shape every real prospect uses. It shows the renderer how to lay out revenue signals, contacts, weaknesses, the demo plan, the score, and ready-to-send outreach.
blocks.why: Revenue clears six figures (two aligned signals), the site has 3+ named fixable weaknesses, and the founder is reachable — the three things that make a prospect worth building for.

contacts.name: Jane Founder
contacts.notes: On two DTC podcasts in the last 6 months — strong accessibility signal.

weaknesses.issue: Subscribe-and-save lives on a separate page, not the PDP
weaknesses.why: Major LTV leak on a daily consumable; most buyers never reach the subscription page.

weaknesses.issue: Reviews buried below the fold, not beside the buy box
weaknesses.why: Social proof isn't visible at the decision point, costing conversion.

weaknesses.issue: No sticky add-to-cart on a long PDP
weaknesses.why: Buy button scrolls away on mobile, where most traffic is.

weaknesses.issue: Generic stock hero, no value proposition above the fold
weaknesses.why: Cold ad traffic hits the homepage with no reason-to-believe.

demo.rationale: They run product-level Meta ads straight to the bestseller PDP — rebuild where the buying decision happens.
mechanics: Inline one-time vs subscribe-and-save selector with the saving shown
Reviews + press logos pulled up beside the buy box
Per-day cost maths under the price

prospect.scrutiny: Passes the critic: revenue clears six figures on two aligned signals (review velocity + sustained ad spend, not one wishful number), the founder is publicly active and genuinely reachable, and the off-PDP subscribe leak is a real repeat-revenue fix on a daily consumable, not a nitpick. Worth an hour to build the demo.

outreach.subject: quick thing about your site
outreach.body:
Hey Jane,

Randomly ended up on your site the other night (your [bestseller] caught my eye) and went down a bit of a rabbit hole. Really like what you've built.

One small thing jumped out: the subscribe option is tucked away on its own page, so most people probably never spot it. Felt like an easy win, so I mocked up a version with it right on the product page. No agenda, just thought you might want to see it:

[demo link]

Either way, nice store.

[Your name]

outreach.subject: your bestseller page
outreach.body:
Hi Jane,

I was on your [bestseller] page and noticed the subscribe option isn't on the product page itself, it's a click away, so most people never see it. On a daily-use product that's a big repeat-revenue leak.

I rebuilt the page to show one-time vs subscribe inline with the saving, pulled your reviews up next to the buy button, and added a sticky add-to-cart for mobile. Quick before/after, no charge:

[demo link]

Worth a look?

[Your name]

outreach.subject: rebuilt your product page (free)
outreach.body:
Hi Jane,

I rebuilt your [bestseller] page as a free demo: inline subscribe-and-save, reviews by the buy box, sticky mobile cart. Here's the before/after:

[demo link]

If it's useful, happy to walk through it on a quick call.

[Your name]

prospect.caveats: Revenue is an estimate from review velocity + ad activity, not filed accounts (US brand, no Companies House). DTC-only figure. Email is a pattern guess, not verified. Lighthouse not yet run.
